You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.

Recipe: Pit Trap (Level 1). A pit with stakes in the bottom. Dig it on a trail, brush it over, wait.
Watching A person, maybe 30s work the pit — the depth, the stakes, the brushed-over leaves — you finally see the shape of it. You could dig one now.
Recipe: Snare (Level 1). You have seen a snare. A loop, a stick, an animal.

🪤 A person, maybe 30s catches you watching the snares come off the line. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They show you — the loop, the trigger stick, where the run narrows between the roots. "Opossum trails. Check at dawn. Always." Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
💧 A person, maybe 40s, with freckles returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 40s returns with water: +3 clean.
"Hey." A man, maybe 30s settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 30s.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
